name: graph-topology
description: The Graph-Topology conversation in the editor: everything each turn did, code written and checked, projects read whole. A thin client of a server at a URL you choose.

graphTopology.serverUrl.description: Where the server is. Any server that answers /api/health (v697, v698, or a later one) can be attached; a restart there is a reconnect here.

graphTopology.serverCommand.description: How to start the server, if this editor should be able to start, stop and restart it (e.g. `python -m research.v698 --workers 19`). Empty: attach only.

graphTopology.serverCwd.description: Where the server command is run. Empty: the first workspace folder.

graphTopology.autoStart.description: Start the server with the command above when the editor opens and none is answering.

graphTopology.projectInclude.description: Which files are read as the project.

graphTopology.maxFiles.description: At most this many files are sent.

graphTopology.maxFileBytes.description: A file larger than this is left out (minified bundles, generated code).

graphTopology.syncOnSave.description: Once the project is read, send each file again when it is saved, and say when one is deleted.
